metadata.label_kind: AI-assisted image annotation; approximate image-plane geometry, not calibrated physical ground truth
metadata.method: All 41 originals visually inspected; per-block color and rough top-center manually seeded by assistant; local RGB directional gradient line fitting; individual crop overlay review; visible top/side edge corrections and repeat-pose registration; angle computed from corners, not estimated by eye. No HSV/Lab candidate model output used as ground truth. No independent human verification or calibrated pixel-error guarantee.
metadata.coordinates: Original 1280x720 image pixel coordinates; x right, y down. Quad = top face only; clockwise ordered starting at topmost vertex (tie leftmost). Center = intersection of diagonals. Angle = square-symmetry circular mean of four edge headings, degrees in [0,90), clockwise-positive in image coordinates. Compare angles modulo 90 and corners by optimal cyclic alignment. Physical XY or physical angle requires homography/calibration.
metadata.scope: 8 visible cubes per image: 2 red, 2 green, 2 blue, 2 wood. Cube IDs unique within image, not tracked across images.
metadata.primary_eval_policy: All 41 frames, including slight truncation, borderline visibility and repeated layouts, are included in primary evaluation at user request. Evaluate detection/color for all 328 cube occurrences. Evaluate center, corner, angle and area errors only for valid_geometry=true (318). For incomplete/borderline cubes, detection_match_point is an approximate matching anchor only, not geometric ground truth. Full-visibility and deduplicated subsets remain available as optional diagnostics.
metadata.uncertainty: All coordinates are estimates from image evidence; weak_boundary flag = low gradient support or edge geometry inconsistency, not a calibrated error estimate. Incomplete top faces have null quad, center, angle and visible_quad with null missing points. Do not use those for geometry metrics. No physical angle or world mm coordinates supplied. Slight truncation is included in detection/color evaluation without inferring missing geometry.
metadata.provenance: Per-image SHA256 of original ZIP PNG bytes; index chronological by filename; per-image labels in frames[0].cubes.
metadata.near_contact_definition: Distance <=4px between estimated visible top-face polygons; proximity proxy, not proof of physical contact.
metadata.radial_definition: Distance from image center (640,360), proxy for optical axis: center <300px, middle 300–<500px, outer >=500px.
metadata.precision: Coordinates rounded to 0.01px for computation, not claimed annotation accuracy. Angle rounded to 0.01deg for computation.
metadata.detection_match_point_definition: For complete cubes, detection_match_point is the annotated center. For incomplete/borderline cubes, it is the midpoint of the two visible opposite top-face vertices (approximate under perspective). Use for association, never for geometric error scoring.
